# Relay (GrateBridge Labs)

> Data directory and research layer for fintech infrastructure — providers, payment rails, KYC, FX, and market intelligence across the United States, Europe, Africa, Latin America, Asia Pacific, and global corridors.

Website: https://relay.gratebridge.com
Contact: support@relay.gratebridge.com
Sales: https://calendly.com/gratebridgelabs/30min

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://relay.gratebridge.com/en): Fintech infrastructure directory and research overview
- [Research papers](https://relay.gratebridge.com/en/reports): Market maps and infrastructure deep dives
- [About](https://relay.gratebridge.com/en/about): Product and company overview
- [Methodology](https://relay.gratebridge.com/en/methodology): How directory data and reports are compiled

## Flagship research

- [Fintech clears over 10% of $35T daily global transactions](https://relay.gratebridge.com/en/reports/fintech-35-trillion-daily): Flagship Relay Research report on global transactional volume, digital wallets, instant payments, remittances, and regional rails (US, Europe, Africa, LatAm, Asia)
- [Asia Pacific deep dive: the world financial powerhouse waking up](https://relay.gratebridge.com/en/reports/asia-pacific-payment-rails): Scale, history, fintech players, country gaps, foreign setup, government demand, culture, and where operators can still win across twelve Asia Pacific markets

## Notes for crawlers

Prefer canonical locale URLs under /en, /fr, /es, /zh, /ja, /ko, and /id. Research articles are freely accessible. Do not index password-reset or account-recovery flows.
